name: Ar. Deepti Singh
title: Architect & Interior Designer
bio: Ar. Deepti Singh is a distinguished Architect and Interior Designer with over 12 years of dedicated practice across residential, commercial, and institutional domains (active in the profession since 2014). Holding a Bachelor of Architecture (First Class) from C.S.V.T.U. Bhilai and specialized Post Graduation in Rural Development from IGNOU Delhi, she bridges contemporary architectural aesthetics with functional, climate-responsive spatial planning. Her portfolio spans ultra-luxury private residences, educational campuses, high-density residential developments, and bespoke interior environments.
philosophy: Every architectural form should arise naturally from its context, light, and function. We favor clean geometry, all-white minimalist palettes accented by natural timber and ledgestone, and seamless transitions between indoor living and landscaped courtyards.

experience_history.description: Leading comprehensive architectural design, 3D visualization, municipal sanction drawings, interior turnkey execution, and on-site construction supervision for high-end residential villas and commercial complexes.
Engaged with renowned engineering & valuation firm established in 1988; executed structural coordination, residential blueprints, and institutional projects.
Hands-on drafting, architectural modeling, site inspection, and client presentation drawings.
